cohort: 122 primiparous pregnant women referred to comprehensive health services in Shahrekord, Iran in 2019.
finding: Prenatal education significantly decreased health anxiety and the duration of active and latent labor phases, and significantly increased newborn weight in the intervention group compared to the control group.
mod_finding: No significant difference was found in the type of delivery between the intervention and control groups.
birth_weight: Newborn weight was measured, and was significantly higher in the intervention group.
gest_age: Participants were pregnant women from 20 to 37 weeks of gestation, and gestational age at delivery was measured.
